pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: feature/android-9
pullRequests.body:
Android minimum lowered from 10 (API 29) to 9 (API 28): minSdk, the android-arm64 preset and Embree's Android build.
Custom GPU drivers (Turnip) load on Android 9: libadrenotools gets a folder for the patched system libraries, since memfd is not certain below Android 10. Android 10+ unchanged.
Same renderer, Enhanced graphics and effects on every version; nothing turned off.
On Android 9 uninstalling does not ask to keep the app's data, and the system WebView stays at Chrome 138.

Each level's camera code makes a collision moby (class 1007); the port called an empty stub instead.

pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): Giant Clank Quit menu Exit makes Clank small
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/giant-clank-quit-exit
pullRequests.body:
Exit called an empty stub instead of Quartu's end-of-Giant-Clank function, so Clank stayed giant.
The stub is now a level hook on PAL and NTSC-U; vehicle_mode goes 2 to 0 after Exit on both.

pullRequests.title: feat(sdk): views of the game and a shared Vulkan device, interface 1.4
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/mod-views
pullRequests.body:
Gets the port ready for a VR mod, without adding one. A native mod can now show the game in a headset; the mod owns OpenXR, and the port links no VR library.
The motivation is a future port of the Ratchet & Clank VR mod by npiriou (Rerac-vr, made for ReRAC), which we have permission to bring to OpenRAC. No code of it is in this PR.
What a mod gets (interface 1.4, SDK 1.4.0)

pullRequests.title: feat(mods): add reusable map packs and native map sessions
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: codex/custom-map-mods-20261027
pullRequests.body:
Adds the reusable tools for a creator to export an edited Godot world as a named map mod and launch it in OpenRAC. This patch contains the framework, documentation and synthetic tests; it includes no authored game map or disc-derived assets.
The exporter editor/map_mod.py combines a project's terrain and the selected level's packed gameplay/collision files into a format-3 map pack. Older tools reject this format. The launcher installs map packs through Mods, identifies them as maps and passes…

keeps the measurements on while one is set.

what it took: frame, game and GPU time percentiles, a verdict (keeps its
